question: Reverse Pickup Enquiry (Returns)
answer: For a reverse pickup, go to My Orders > Return/Replace and choose a pickup slot. You'll get an SMS/email with the pickup date. Keep the item in its original packaging with all tags and accessories ready for the agent.

question: Return request (Returns)
answer: To raise a return, open My Orders > Return Item within the return window (usually 7-10 days of delivery). Select a reason, choose refund or replacement, and a prepaid return label is emailed to you.

question: Delayed (Order Related)
answer: If your order is delayed, check live status under My Orders > Track. Most delayed orders arrive within 3-5 business days. If tracking hasn't updated in 48 hours, we can raise a delivery investigation for you.

question: Order status enquiry (Order Related)
answer: You can see your order's current status any time under My Orders > Track. The page shows dispatch, in-transit, and out-for-delivery stages with the expected date.

question: Fraudulent User (Returns)
answer: If you suspect fraudulent activity on your account or an order you did not place, change your password immediately and report it under Help > Report Fraud. We will secure the account and investigate.

question: Installation/demo (Order Related)
answer: Installation or demo for eligible products is scheduled after delivery. Track or reschedule it under My Orders > Services. A technician visit is usually arranged within 2-4 business days.

question: Product Specific Information (Product Queries)
answer: Detailed specifications, size guides, warranty, and reviews are on the product page. For compatibility or usage questions, share the product name and we'll pull the details.

question: Missing (Returns)
answer: If an item is missing from your delivery, report it under My Orders > Report an Issue within 48 hours. We'll verify the package weight/scan and arrange the missing item or a refund.

question: Wrong (Returns)
answer: Received the wrong item? Start a return under My Orders > Return Item and select 'Wrong item received'. We'll arrange a free pickup and send the correct product or issue a refund.

question: Refund Enquiry (Refund Related)
answer: Refunds are issued to your original payment method once the returned item is received and inspected. Bank refunds take 5-7 business days; wallet/store-credit refunds are usually instant. Track it under My Orders > Refund Status.

question: UnProfessional Behaviour (Feedback)
answer: We're sorry about your experience. Please share the order ID and what happened under Help > Feedback. We take agent conduct seriously and will review it with the team.

question: Service Centres Related (Returns)
answer: To find an authorised service centre, go to My Orders > Services > Locate Centre and enter your pincode. Carry the invoice and warranty card for in-warranty service.

question: Refund Related Issues (Refund Related)
answer: If a refund is delayed beyond the expected window, verify the refund reference under My Orders > Refund Status. If it's still pending after 7 business days, we can escalate it for a priority review.

question: Not Needed (Cancellation)
answer: To cancel an order you no longer need, go to My Orders > Cancel as long as it hasn't shipped. Any amount paid is refunded automatically after cancellation.

question: General Enquiry (Shopzilla Related)
answer: You can manage most things under My Account and My Orders. Tell me a bit more about what you need and I'll point you to the right place.

question: Invoice request (Order Related)
answer: Download your invoice any time under My Orders > Invoice > Download. A GST invoice is available for eligible orders.

question: Online Payment Issues (Payments related)
answer: If a payment failed but money was deducted, it is auto-reversed within 3-5 business days. If the order wasn't confirmed, share the transaction ID and we'll verify it.

question: Priority delivery (Order Related)
answer: Priority or faster delivery options, where available, are shown at checkout for your pincode. Already-placed orders can't be upgraded to priority after dispatch.

question: Customer Requested Modifications (Order Related)
answer: Address or item changes are possible only before the order ships. Go to My Orders > Edit Order. After dispatch, you can refuse delivery or use the return flow.

question: Seller Cancelled Order (Order Related)
answer: If a seller cancelled your order, any amount paid is refunded in full automatically. You can reorder from another seller on the product page.

question: Exchange / Replacement (Returns)
answer: To exchange or replace an item, use My Orders > Return/Replace and pick 'Replacement'. The new item ships once the pickup is completed.

question: Payment related Queries (Payments related)
answer: We support cards, UPI, net banking, and wallets. For EMI or coupon issues, confirm the offer conditions (minimum value, eligible cards) are met at checkout.

question: Signup Issues (Shopzilla Related)
answer: If you're having trouble signing up, make sure your email/phone isn't already registered. Clear the app cache or try a different browser, then request a fresh OTP.

question: Damaged (Returns)
answer: Sorry your item arrived damaged. Start a return under My Orders > Return Item and select 'Damaged'. You're eligible for a free replacement or a full refund.

question: Shopzila Premium Related (Shopzilla Related)
answer: For 'Shopzila Premium Related' under Shopzilla Related, you can usually resolve this from My Orders or My Account. Open the related order, choose the matching option, and follow the on-screen steps. If you still need help, I can connect you with an agent.
